scholarships.name: NNPC/Chevron JV National University Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Full-time 200-level undergraduates in Nigerian federal universities, STEM courses, strong academic record.

scholarships.name: MTN Foundation Science & Technology Scholarship
scholarships.window: Typically opens in the second half of the year
scholarships.eligibility: Science and technology undergraduates in public Nigerian institutions with a strong CGPA.

scholarships.name: Shell Nigeria University Scholarship (SPDC JV)
scholarships.window: Typically opens in the third quarter
scholarships.eligibility: Nigerian undergraduates in approved courses; priority for host-community candidates.

scholarships.name: TotalEnergies National Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate and postgraduate students in STEM disciplines at Nigerian institutions.

scholarships.name: PTDF Overseas & Local Scholarship
scholarships.window: Typically opens early in the year
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduates, masters and PhD candidates in engineering, geosciences and energy-related fields.

scholarships.name: NDDC Foreign & Local Postgraduate Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Graduates from Niger Delta states with a good first degree, for masters and PhD study.

scholarships.name: Nigeria LNG Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: 100-level undergraduates in Nigerian universities with outstanding UTME results.

scholarships.name: Seplat Energy JV National Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.window: Typically opens in the second quarter
scholarships.eligibility: 200-level undergraduates in federal and state universities, strong academic standing.

scholarships.name: BEA Bilateral Education Agreement Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Federal Scholarship Board, Federal Ministry of Education
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate and postgraduate study in partner countries under Nigeria's bilateral agreements.
